story.title: PayPal stakes AI-led turnaround on $1.5B in savings as it cuts jobs and rebuilds tech stack
story.summary: PayPal has publicly committed to an AI-driven transformation strategy, tying automation initiatives to $1.5 billion in projected savings while simultaneously cutting workers and modernising its underlying technology infrastructure. CEO Alex Chriss described the shift as the company "becoming a technology company again," framing AI as the engine of a broader reinvention. The announcement highlights a growing pattern among legacy fintech firms using AI efficiency narratives to justify headcount reductions.
